items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer states Ira Sullivan was a neighbor of the interviewer, not the interviewee. The interviewee's response 'And this is really what -- that was my first introduction to him' refers to the previous topic or the interviewer's story, not a personal connection with Sullivan.

ctx.x: And this is really what -- that was my first introduction to him, you know.
Ira Sullivan used to be a neighbor of mine (inaudible).
